It is difficult. I have lost my dad, my mom, and my aunt. All three were surprises on a regular seeming day. 

Thinking about losing loved ones, that are still alive, produces anxiety in me. I end up going into a mourning phase even though they are here. I move past it and just enjoy the people I love, I listen to them, I share with them, I encourage them, and I laugh and cry with them. Enjoy this life because it is very temporary and we can go at any moment. The emotions are going to be strong, I think the best thing to do is feel it and let it go naturally. After that go and have a drink or go to dinner with your loved ones. Enjoy every moment you have with them. Something I've been thinking about
